snippet.title: Town of Zoz | Official Launch Trailer | Balor Games
snippet.description:
Fight with flavor! Town of Zoz is out NOW on Steam: https://balor.gg/TownOfZoz

As Ito, a young shaman chef adventurer, you'll hunt critters, gather ingredients, and rebuild bonds by cooking for the townspeople. A shaman chef always aims to lend a helping hand, but the more Ito gets involved, the more he'll learn about the town and its ancient secrets.

Your hometown is waiting. Come home to Zoz. 💜
